title: Family Photo Cloud
scenario: A message says family photos will be deleted unless you renew storage immediately.

answers.A: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.B: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.C: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.
answers.D: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.

explanation: Family Photo Cloud: the trap is to turn convenience into a device or network security risk. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Cloud storage renewals belong in the official account.
